summary: Visual review, iteration 1, of the three build PDFs of liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints (claude). All 46 pages were inspected at full size from the run's build-artifacts-1 rasters (200 dpi, 1700x2200), after the contact sheets: the expansive study f02-all-saints.pdf (sha256 08f8c5e99572d5f8a9584555c47b901bc32abd09fdf74dd5d7094f387143c3bc), pages 1-31 of 31; the concise study f02-all-saints-synthesis.pdf (fb899d0258fe16641fb2be454eb088f37fd41011012fe599b5fb2d5ac397c881), pages 1-11 of 11; and the homily f02-all-saints-homily.pdf (a6630b389583e729bbaa18103fb48364e2767d47485ecbddeb4ddbef4d3bc2ac), pages 1-4 of 4. All 32 sealed REVIEW_INPUTS paths match their bytes on disk; research/artifacts.json equals the seal; and the raster run's review-run.json records the same three PDF hashes. Checked evidence: letter pages; all content inside the 0.75-inch margins (content box x 147-1554 px of 1700, with glyph overhang only); every page monochrome (zero saturation); Latin Modern Type 1 subsets only, all embedded; no overfull, underfull, undefined-reference or rerun warnings in the three logs and no '??' in the text layers; PDF ModDate equal to the tracked revision 2026-10-28T17:52:51Z, which is printed once above the compact rights colophon on the final page of each document (the shared colophon suppresses that page's head and folio by design); neither study is set in columns; the homily has a full-width title, a two-column speech with no parentheses, loci or apparatus, and a separate full-width Note on Sources and Delivery and References. The three \properlane headings are consistent, and each lane closes with its own Literal/Allegorical/Moral/Anagogical block. Pagination: 31 pages (20-50) and 11 pages (10-12). The concise aux markers settle at inventory, overview and the four sense rows on physical page 1, chronology on 2, themes on 3-4 and commentary on 5, and the pages agree: page 1 holds the complete 14-element map in liturgical order, with the three commemorations and the two Preface options shown as options, and exactly four sense rows; page 2 holds only Scriptural Date and Location; pages 3-4 are a substantive Themes and Movement, opening on thesis prose with no wrapper label; and the interleaved commentary, organized by three cross-proper questions, begins at the top of page 5. Passage lookup at normal reading size on concise page 2, with study page 27 identical: the Communion's Mt 5:8-10 is found in the Passage cell 'Alleluia: Matthew 11:28; Gospel: Matthew 5:1-12; Communion: Matthew 5:8-10', which pairs in the same top-aligned row with 'Composition: The Gospel of St Matthew' and 'Disputed: c. A.D. 38-45 ... c. A.D. 50'. The Gospel's event row pairs the unnamed mountain after the circuit of Galilee with 'Date unresolved'. The Lesson's Apoc 7:2-12 pairs with Patmos and 'Disputed: A.D. 81-96; c. A.D. 90-100', and the note directly below glosses Revelation as the Apocalypse. Outcome: the passage-occurrence-date pairing is visible across each row without reading down another column. The place leg is unanswered in four rows, which neither name a place nor say it is unknown (advisory VIS-005). Standing findings: VIS-001 (the orphaned concise page-9 running head) is repaired, since page 9 is now headed Detailed Commentary and Scope and References first appears on page 10, where the appendix begins. VIS-003 is repaired: the concise text layer now closes the nested Aquinas quotation with a single and then a double quote, and has 100 opening and 100 closing double quotes. VIS-002 stands as an advisory in the unchanged study source. VIS-004 stays accepted. Limits: the installed pdf/ mirror and the web edition were not reviewed, as they belong to later stages; no source text was verified against its witnesses, which is outside this lane. Verdict: PASS, with two advisories (VIS-002, VIS-005) and two accepted findings (VIS-004, VIS-006). This dispatch contributed an independent full-page visual review of the three F02 build PDFs at the sealed hashes, including the page-2 passage lookup and checks that the earlier visual findings were repaired.
